format_promise: A concise editable pitch deck that demonstrates a working system, measurable engineering, and candidate-integrity safeguards.
anti_format: synthetic metrics presented as production performance
dense architecture diagrams with unreadable labels

canvas_and_grid.header_policy: short measured Chinese titles with body below the reserved header
canvas_and_grid.column_policy: two-column evidence compositions with consistent gutters

palette_role_map.background: navy opener and pale blue content fields
palette_role_map.accent: orange for product moments, green for verified outcomes
